cases.description: 订单明细先按订单聚合再连接客户，避免金额重复
cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.id, c.name, SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id GROUP BY o.id, c.name ORDER BY o.id

cases.description: 孤儿外键使用 INNER JOIN 时不应出现在结果
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id=c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY c.id

cases.description: 维度缺失时保留明细并显式标记未知
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.name, '未知客户') AS customer_name, SUM(i.amount) AS total_amount FROM order_items i LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.name, '未知客户') ORDER BY customer_name

cases.description: 订单同时连接明细和收款时，两个多侧必须先按订单聚合
cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.id, SUM(i.total_amount) AS item_amount, SUM(p.total_paid) AS paid_amount FROM orders o LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) i ON i.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount) AS total_paid FROM payments GROUP BY order_id) p ON p.order_id=o.id WHERE o.id IN (1,2) GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.id
cases.naive_sql: SELECT o.id, SUM(i.amount) AS item_amount, SUM(p.amount) AS paid_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id=o.id JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o.id WHERE o.id IN (1,2) GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.id
